goal: Allows hardware signers to verify change outputs and sign multisig PSBTs directly
Eliminates manual xpub injection workarounds required by wallet coordinators
agreement: Substantive support with all prior reviewer objections addressed
Tested ACK after confirming suggestions and edge cases are pinned by tests (fametrano)
Concept ACK because adding global xpubs helps external signers without harm (vicjuma)
Earlier design objections on descriptor handling and MuSig were resolved (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes multisig signing failures on hardware signers like BitBox02
Hardware signers can verify change outputs instead of receiving zeroed chain codes
External coordinators no longer need custom workarounds to manually inject xpubs
